win_system.notes:
WAYS TO WIN

 The specified requirements for a winning combination in the base game are also used during bonus features or free spins play unless otherwise stated. Each wager is eligible for all winning combinations unless otherwise stated.

 You win if matching symbols appear along one of the following predefined lines from left to right starting from the leftmost reel. Wins may also be formed from right to left, top to bottom, and bottom to top, depending on the active pay directions and start

wilds.name: CRAZY CAT SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior: Crazy Cat symbols are Wild multipliers. Landed Crazy Cat symbols will display or reveal one of the following possible multiplier values: x2, x3, x4, x5, x6, x7, x8, x9, x10, x15, x20. When a Crazy Cat symbol participates in a winning combination, the value of the win is multiplied by the shown value. If more than one Crazy Cat symbol is part of the same winning combination, their values are first multiplied with each other before being applied to the win.

wilds.name: PAY DIRECTION ARROWS AND WILD PLUS SYMBOLS
wilds.behavior:
Four Pay Direction Arrows are located outside the grid. These arrows indicate the direction in which winning paylines are calculated. The left Pay Direction Arrow is standard and is always active.

 The other arrows are activated by landing a Wild Plus symbol. Wild Plus symbols trigger immediately upon landing before any wins are awarded. A landed Wild Plus symbol activates 1-3 additional payline directions in clockwise order, starting from the top Pay Direction Arrow. Pay Direction Arrows will reset when the next spin is initiated.

 Winning paylines are awarded from one direction at a time, starting from the left and going clockwise through each activated Pay Direction.
